audit.why: EVEN 6/10 kept. The packet flags the 76.47% win rate against a Gragas-heavy chart, but that is 17 games and the mirror already settled the chart shape rather than the difficulty.
audit.corrected: Difficulty framing kept; the chart rows are the fix.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3, Levels 4-5 and Level 6 disagreed with the packet chart and with the mirror audit.
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill, Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas and the mirror moved win[2] to Skill and win[3]/win[4] to Gragas. This page's own whys already read that way: Level 3 is 'my most even window', 4-5 goes to his sustain, and 6 gives him the better ultimate.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 3 and 4 flipped as matched pairs in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly credits sustain to a 'Q pool'. Barrel Roll is a rolled cask that explodes and slows — it has no pool and no healing.
audit.why: Riot text: Barrel Roll rolls a cask that explodes after up to 4 seconds, slowing. The healing is Happy Hour, the passive that heals periodically on skill use — which is also why Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades. Drunken Rage carries the autoReset flag on a 5s cooldown, so the wind-up is the burst tell. Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, and the full layer never gave a number for it.
audit.corrected: whys[3], spikes[2].text and wants.foe[1] moved onto Happy Hour; dosFull[0].d carries Body Slam's 14s; dontsFull[0].d states the Drunken Rage reset tell; dontsFull[1].d adds anti-heal.

edits.before: His Q pool out-sustains my W-burn chip through 4-5, so the grind goes his way even though I control the wave.
edits.after: Happy Hour heals him on every cast, out-sustaining my W burn through 4-5 even though I control the wave.

edits.before: Gragas' biggest threat window: his R can knock you out of your own Q chain or peel you off, and his Q pool out-sustains your W burn in a brawl.
edits.after: Gragas' biggest threat window: Explosive Cask knocks you out of your own Q chain or peels you off, and Happy Hour heals through your W burn in a brawl.

edits.before: Out-sustain your W burn with his Q pool in a prolonged AP brawl
edits.after: Out-sustain your W burn with Happy Hour heals in a long AP brawl

edits.before: His engage. Q-peel after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Body Slam is 14s at rank 1 — commit only once he has spent the dash.

edits.before: That is Gragas's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Drunken Rage is a 5s auto reset — his wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step back.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.

notes: 'Q pool' appears in the content layer as Gragas's sustain source; it is not in his kit at all — Barrel Roll is a cask, the healing is Happy Hour. Corrected in the three places it appeared.
